info.title: MARE API
info.description: Generated OpenAPI specification for MARE API V1 routes.

tags.name: Observations
tags.description: Access biological observation records and related data. These endpoints support observation retrieval, filtering, aggregation, review workflows, video-based queries, keyframe associations, and observation updates.

Artifact.description: A tracked output file (weights, log, plot, export, etc.) produced during a training run, including its path, size, checksum, and optional contextual metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for this artifact record.

training_run_id.description: Foreign key referencing the training run this artifact belongs to (training_runs.id).

path.description: Filesystem path or URI to the artifact file or directory.

size_mb.description: File size in megabytes, if available (useful for monitoring disk usage).

hash.description: Checksum or hash of the artifact file (e.g., SHA256) to verify integrity and detect duplicates.

metadata.description: Optional JSON blob with contextual information (e.g., epoch number, export format, or framework version).

created_at.description: Timestamp when this artifact record was created (typically when the file was generated).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this artifact record was last updated.

DatasetObservation.description: Join record linking a dataset to one observation it includes, with metadata describing how and why that observation was selected for the dataset (train/val/test split, selection method, and sampling weight).

id.description: Unique identifier for this dataset-observation record.

dataset_id.description: Foreign key referencing the dataset that includes this observation (datasets.id).

observation_id.description: Foreign key referencing the observation included in this dataset (observations.observation_id).

inclusion_type.description: Indicates how this observation is used in the dataset ("train", "val", or "test").

selection_method.description: Describes how this observation was chosen for inclusion (e.g., "manual", "auto", "random_sample", "legacy_import").

weight.description: Optional weighting factor applied to this observation within the dataset for class balancing or sampling probability.

notes.description: Freeform notes about this dataset-observation inclusion (e.g., reasons for inclusion/exclusion, data quality remarks).

created_at.description: Timestamp when this dataset-observation record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this dataset-observation record was last updated.

Dataset.description: Curated collection of observations used for machine learning training, validation, or testing. Linked to individual observations through the dataset_observations join table.

id.description: Unique identifier for this dataset record.

description.description: Detailed description or notes about the dataset's purpose and composition.

location.description: Filesystem or network location of the dataset resources.

num_samples.description: Total number of samples (images, frames, or observations) included in this dataset.

num_classes.description: Approximate number of unique classes (species) represented in this dataset (derived from observation comnames).

source.description: Source or method of dataset creation (e.g., "auto-compiled", "manual curation", "legacy import").

notes.description: General notes about dataset preparation, inclusion criteria, or issues.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this dataset record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this dataset record was last updated.

Epoch.description: Per-epoch performance and timing data captured during a single training run, including loss values and precision/recall/mAP metrics recorded at the end of that epoch.

id.description: Unique identifier for this epoch record.

training_run_id.description: Foreign key linking this epoch to its parent training run (training_runs.id).

epoch_number.description: The ordinal number of this epoch in the training sequence.

start_time.description: Timestamp marking when this epoch began processing.

end_time.description: Timestamp marking when this epoch completed.

duration_seconds.description: Total elapsed time of this epoch, in seconds (end_time - start_time).

precision.description: Precision metric value recorded at the end of this epoch.

recall.description: Recall metric value recorded at the end of this epoch.

map50.description: Mean Average Precision (mAP) at 0.5 IoU threshold for this epoch.

map5095.description: Mean Average Precision (mAP) averaged across IoU thresholds 0.5–0.95 for this epoch.

box_loss.description: Loss associated with bounding box coordinate regression during this epoch.

cls_loss.description: Loss associated with class label predictions during this epoch.

dfl_loss.description: Distribution Focal Loss (DFL) for this epoch, if applicable to the model type.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when this epoch record was inserted into the database.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this epoch record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this epoch record was last updated.

Hyperparameters.description: Full hyperparameter configuration used for a specific training run, stored as a JSON blob to preserve reproducibility of training conditions across differing pipelines and model types.

id.description: Unique identifier for this hyperparameter configuration.

training_run_id.description: Foreign key referencing the training run this hyperparameter set belongs to (training_runs.id).

params.description: JSON blob containing all hyperparameters used for this training run (e.g., lr0, momentum, epochs, batch, weight decay, augmentation options). Keys vary by training pipeline and are not individually enumerated here.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this hyperparameter record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this hyperparameter record was last updated.

Keyframe.description: Frame-specific annotation associated with an observation.

MetaInfo.description: A single named metadata record used to store miscellaneous reference information for MARP.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this metadata record.

MetricsCurve.description: A single confidence-threshold data point (precision, recall, F1, support) belonging to a metrics_summary record, used to plot detailed evaluation curves.

id.description: Unique identifier for this metrics curve data point.

metrics_summary_id.description: Foreign key referencing the metrics summary record (metrics_summary.id) this curve point belongs to.

species_id.description: Foreign key referencing the species this summary applies to. NULL means it represents an aggregate across all species.

confidence_threshold.description: Confidence threshold (between 0.0 and 1.0) at which these metrics were measured.

precision.description: Model precision value computed at this confidence threshold.

recall.description: Model recall value computed at this confidence threshold.

f1_score.description: Model F1 score computed at this confidence threshold.

support.description: Number of predictions or detections evaluated at this confidence threshold.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this metrics curve record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this metrics curve record was last updated.

MetricsSummary.description: Aggregated evaluation metrics for a single dataset split (train/val/test) within a training run, including paths to generated visualization artifacts and optional per-class detail.

id.description: Unique identifier for this metrics summary record.

training_run_id.description: Foreign key referencing the training run this metrics summary belongs to (training_runs.id).

species_id.description: Foreign key referencing the species this summary applies to. NULL means it represents an aggregate across all species.

dataset_split.description: Specifies which dataset split these metrics apply to - "train", "val", or "test".

precision.description: Aggregate precision achieved for this dataset split.

recall.description: Aggregate recall achieved for this dataset split.

map50.description: Mean Average Precision (mAP) at 0.5 IoU threshold for this split.

map5095.description: Mean Average Precision (mAP) averaged over IoU thresholds 0.5-0.95.

fitness.description: Weighted performance score used by YOLO to rank model checkpoints.

f1_score.description: Aggregate F1 score for this dataset split, typically computed from precision and recall.

confusion_matrix_path.description: Filesystem path or URI to the confusion matrix image generated for this dataset split.

result_plot_path.description: Filesystem path or URI to the overall results plot (e.g., PR or F1 curves) for this dataset split.

confusion_matrix_norm_path.description: Path to the normalized confusion matrix plot image generated during evaluation.

box_f1_curve_path.description: Path to the F1 vs confidence curve plot image.

box_p_curve_path.description: Path to the precision vs confidence curve plot image.

box_pr_curve_path.description: Path to the precision-recall (PR) curve plot image.

box_r_curve_path.description: Path to the recall vs confidence curve plot image.

labels_plot_path.description: Path to the label distribution plot image showing class balance in the dataset.

details.description: Optional JSON blob storing additional data arrays (e.g., per-class metrics or PR/F1-confidence points).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when this metrics summary was created or finalized.

MlModel.description: Metadata record for a distinct machine learning model identity used within MARP (e.g., "yolov8-marine-fish-2025"). Represents the conceptual model itself, not any individual training run; runs, metrics, and artifacts are linked through the training_runs table.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this ML model record.

parent_model_id.description: If this model was derived or fine-tuned from another, references that parent model's ID.

architecture_version.description: Specific version or variant of the architecture (e.g., "v8n", "custom-2025a").

storage_path.description: Filesystem or URI path to the stored model weights and artifacts.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the model ("draft", "training", "trained", or "archived").

notes.description: Freeform notes providing experiment details, context, or remarks.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this model entry was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this model record was last updated.

ModelSpecies.description: Join record linking an ML model to a species it was trained to detect or classify, including per-species dataset size, training weight, and evaluation metrics.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this model-species linkage record.

model_id.description: Identifier of the associated ML model.

dataset_size.description: Number of image or annotation samples of this species used for training this model.

balance_weight.description: Relative weight used for balancing this species during training. Higher means more importance.

precision_mean.description: Mean precision achieved by the model for this species during evaluation.

recall_mean.description: Mean recall achieved by the model for this species during evaluation.

f1_mean.description: Mean F1-score for this species within this model, across validation epochs.

notes.description: Freeform notes describing this model-species relationship.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated.

Observation.description: Biological or habitat observation recorded during a MARP session. The fields available in a response may depend on the query and any Sequelize associations included by that endpoint.

observation_id.description: Primary database identifier for the observation.

obsID.description: Observation identifier used within the source workflow.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project associated with the observation.

session_id.description: Identifier of the session associated with the observation.

user_id.description: Identifier of the user associated with the observation.

tc.description: Starting time code for the observation.

frame.description: Stored source-frame value associated with the observation.

taxserial.description: Taxonomic serial identifier associated with the observation.

comname.description: Common name assigned to the observed taxon.

count.description: Number of individuals represented by the observation.

coarsesize.description: Coarse size classification assigned to the observation.

quadrant.description: Quadrant value associated with the observation.

etc.description: Ending time code for the observation.

note.description: Free-text note associated with the observation.

downcamera.description: Stored down-camera value associated with the observation.

video_source.description: Video source associated with the observation.

videoLocation.description: Stored location of the associated video.

mediaPosition.description: Stored position of the observation within the source media.

actualPosition.description: Stored actual-position value associated with the observation.

substrate_bedrock.description: Indicates whether bedrock substrate was recorded.

substrate_megaclast.description: Indicates whether megaclast substrate was recorded.

substrate_boulder.description: Indicates whether boulder substrate was recorded.

substrate_cobble.description: Indicates whether cobble substrate was recorded.

substrate_pebble.description: Indicates whether pebble substrate was recorded.

substrate_granule.description: Indicates whether granule substrate was recorded.

substrate_sand.description: Indicates whether sand substrate was recorded.

substrate_mud.description: Indicates whether mud substrate was recorded.

substrate_coral_reef.description: Indicates whether coral-reef substrate was recorded.

substrate_coral_rubble.description: Indicates whether coral-rubble substrate was recorded.

substrate_shell_hash.description: Indicates whether shell-hash substrate was recorded.

substrate_shell_rubble.description: Indicates whether shell-rubble substrate was recorded.

substrate_algal.description: Indicates whether algal substrate was recorded.

confidence.description: Machine-learning confidence score between zero and one.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the observation record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the observation record was last updated.

Project.description: Named project grouping used to organize sessions and observations recorded throughout MARP.

project_id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this project.

name.description: Unique display name for the project.

Session.description: Dive or survey session grouping the observations recorded during a single dive/line, along with its owning project and user.

session_id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this session record.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project this session was conducted under.

user_id.description: Identifier of the user who recorded or owns this session.

dive.description: Dive identifier or name associated with this session.

line.description: Transect line identifier associated with this session.

lineId.description: Identifier of the specific survey line tied to this session.

type.description: Type or category of this session (e.g., survey platform or method).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this session record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this session record was last updated.

Species.description: Taxonomic and GUI display entry used to classify observations, datasets, and ML model training labels throughout MARP.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this species record.

taxserial.description: Internal MARP taxonomy serial number used as a unique ID across systems.

gui_home_order.description: Ordering key used by the MARP GUI to position this item on the home screen.

gui_maintab.description: Main tab category where this item appears in the GUI.

gui_subtab.description: Sub-tab within the main tab where this item is displayed.

gui_main_tab_order.description: Order number for the main tab this item belongs to.

gui_sub_tab_order.description: Order number for the sub-tab this item belongs to.

gui_item_order.description: Position of this species within its GUI sub-tab group.

gui_display_name.description: Display name for this item shown in MARP GUI interfaces, may differ from comname.

comname.description: Common name used for this species.

species.description: Scientific or Latin name of the species.

observation_type.description: Category describing what type of organism this is.

report_group.description: Report grouping used for rollups or reports.

depth_min.description: Minimum depth in meters where this species is typically observed.

depth_max.description: Maximum depth in meters where this species is typically observed.

notes.description: Freeform notes about this species, its classification, or GUI behavior.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this species record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this species record was last updated.

Task.description: A discrete work item tracked by MARP, including free-text description and audit fields for who created/updated it and when.

createdate.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

updateddate.description: Timestamp when the task was last updated.

createdby.description: Identifier or username of the person who created the task.

updatedby.description: Identifier or username of the person who last updated the task.

TrainingRun.description: A single training or retraining event of an ML model, linking the model, the dataset used, and the resulting epochs, metrics, and artifacts produced during that run.

id.description: Unique identifier for this training run.

model_id.description: Foreign key referencing the parent ML model (ml_models.id).

dataset_id.description: Foreign key referencing the dataset used for training (datasets.id).

total_epochs.description: Total number of epochs configured for this run.

batch_size.description: Training batch size used during this run.

learning_rate.description: Base learning rate used during training.

augmentation.description: JSON blob containing data augmentation parameters and settings applied during this run. Keys vary by training pipeline.

compute_device.description: Hardware used for training (e.g., "RTX 6000 Ada", "A100 GPU").

train_script_commit.description: Git commit hash or version identifier of the training script used.

notes.description: Freeform notes describing experiment purpose or results context.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this record was last modified.

User.description: Individual who records or owns sessions and observations throughout MARP.

user_id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this user.

name.description: Unique display name for the user.

get.summary: Retrieve the OpenAPI specification from the root alias
get.description: Returns the generated OpenAPI document from the root-level compatibility endpoint.
Serves the generated JSDoc website containing internal source-code and module documentation. This endpoint returns HTML and related static assets rather than a JSON API response.

Returns observations whose video_source exactly matches the supplied videoName. Results are ordered by mediaPosition in ascending order and include associated keyframes. Observations without keyframes are excluded. An empty array may indicate either that no records matched or that the database query failed.

get.summary: Retrieve video summaries for a project
get.description: Returns one summary row for each distinct combination of video_source and videoLocation associated with sessions in the specified project. Each row includes the number of distinct observation common names, the number of distinct sessions, and representative dive, line, and session type values selected using MIN aggregation. Results are ordered by the representative dive and line in ascending order. Videos without a matching session in the project are excluded. An empty array may mean that no matching observations were found or that the database query failed.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Database identifier of the project whose videos should be summarized.

video_source.description: Video source value shared by the grouped observations.

videoLocation.description: Video location value shared by the grouped observations.

distinct_species_count.description: Number of distinct non-null observation comname values.

session_count.description: Number of distinct sessions represented in the group.

dive.description: Minimum dive value among the matching sessions.

line.description: Minimum line value among the matching sessions.

session_type.description: Minimum session type value among the matching sessions.

get.summary: Retrieve video observations filtered by common name
get.description: Returns observations whose video_source exactly matches videoName and whose comname is included in comnameList. Results are ordered by mediaPosition in ascending order and include associated keyframes. Observations without at least one keyframe are excluded. The current repository returns an empty array both when no observations match and when the database query fails.

parameters.name: videoName
parameters.description: Exact value to match against the observation video_source field.

parameters.name: comnameList
parameters.description: Common names used to filter observations. Supply the parameter repeatedly, such as comnameList=Bat%20star&comnameList=Leather%20star.

get.summary: Retrieve observations for a video within a project
get.description: Returns observations whose video_source exactly matches videoName and whose associated session belongs to the project identified by projectName. Results are ordered by mediaPosition in ascending order. Associated keyframes are included when available, but observations without keyframes are also returned. An empty array may indicate that no observations matched, the project was not found, or the database query failed.

parameters.name: videoName
parameters.description: Exact value to match against the observation video_source field.

parameters.name: projectName
parameters.description: Exact project name used to locate the associated project record.

get.summary: Retrieve observations with keyframes by common name
get.description: Returns observations whose comname matches one of the supplied common names. The comnameList query parameter must contain a comma-separated list of URL-encoded common names. Results are ordered by mediaPosition in ascending order and include associated keyframes. Observations without at least one keyframe are excluded. An empty array may indicate that no observations matched or that the repository query failed.

parameters.name: comnameList
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of common names. Each value is decoded after the string is split on commas.

200.description: Matching observations with keyframes returned successfully.

500.description: The API request failed before a response could be produced.

get.description: Returns every task row currently available in storage.
Returns all observation records available through the V1 API.

get.summary: Fetch latest video info for a session
get.description: Returns the most recent video metadata associated with a session.
Returns every species record used for taxonomy, GUI display configuration, and ML model training labels. An empty array may indicate either that no records exist or that the database query failed.

get.summary: Fetch a species by common name
get.description: Returns the species record whose comname matches the supplied value, case-insensitively. Returns null both when no species matches and when the database query fails.

200.description: Matching species returned, or null if not found.

post.description: Creates a model_species join record linking an ML model to a species, using the request body directly as the record to insert. Note that when the insert fails the response body is an ErrorResponse-shaped object, but the endpoint currently still responds with HTTP 200 rather than an error status.

200.description: Model-species record created successfully, or an ErrorResponse body if the insert failed (see description).

get.description: Returns metadata identifying the current configured database.
